abstract: arXiv:2609.20825v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical predictive models often rely on structured Electronic Health Record data, such as time-series and procedure codes. abstract: arXiv:2609.20826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current radiology report generation (RRG) models usually produce descriptive reports based on a single examination or only the most recent prior examination, limiting their ability to perform accurate and meaningful longitudinal comparisons and detect subtle interval changes. abstract: arXiv:2609.20827v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hospital discharge education is an interactive teaching task: a clinician adapts a discharge plan to a patient's literacy, recall, and personality. title: SAGE: Schema-Guided LLMs for Grant Review
abstract: arXiv:2609.20829v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Grant reviewers must apply detailed criteria to application forms, budgets, and supporting documents while producing assessments that colleagues can inspect.
